answer: Price sybils by funding history. Each new identity locks a 2,000 POA bond for 30 epochs, and the bond doubles for every other identity whose first coins came from the same wallet within three hops, so a fifth sibling locks 32,000 POA. Keys can be reset; a funding graph cannot. Publish that graph as an open atlas graders can audit. A lone newcomer pays once and enters the meadow; a farm hits a tundra of frozen capital, and one jury verdict slashes the whole family's bonds.
